# Inter

The renderer imports Inter Variable from the pinned
`@fontsource-variable/inter` package. Vite emits the font files into the local
renderer bundle, so the desktop application makes no font or CDN request at
runtime.

Inter is Copyright 2016 The Inter Project Authors and is distributed under the
SIL Open Font License 1.1. The exact license shipped with the pinned package is
preserved in `LICENSE.txt`.
